name: Portland, OR
program: Blue recycling cart plus separate glass-only bin, compost and garbage (Portland BPS, Metro)

sources.title: Recycling – what goes in the bin | Portland.gov

paperboard-box.quote: Cereal boxes and cardboard egg cartons.

egg-carton-paper.quote: Cereal boxes and cardboard egg cartons.

junk-mail.quote: Mail (envelopes with windows and labels are OK, plastic padding is not).

beverage-carton.quote: Cartons (milk, juice, soup; empty and dry).

pizza-box-greasy.quote: Pizza delivery boxes (Must be empty. No food residue. Small amounts of grease OK.)
pizza-box-greasy.note: Boxes with cheese, sauce or other food on them cannot go in recycling.

paper-cup-hot.quote: NO coffee cups, take-out food containers, paper plates.

paper-takeout-container.quote: NO coffee cups, take-out food containers, paper plates.

paper-plates-napkins.quote: NO paper towels, napkins, facial tissue.

waxed-cardboard.quote: NO wax-coated cardboard or paper coated with food, wax, foil or plastic.

foil-lined-paper.quote: NO wax-coated cardboard or paper coated with food, wax, foil or plastic.

pet-bottle.quote: Plastic bottles* and jars with a neck
pet-bottle.note: Portland sorts plastic by shape and size, not resin number.

plastic-flowerpot.quote: Rigid plant pots (Thin, crinkly plastic pots are not accepted.)

plastic-cup-lid.quote: NO plastic lids (unless they're screwed on)

plastic-cup-disposable.quote: NO plastic disposable plates, cups, or cutlery.

plastic-cutlery.quote: NO plastic disposable plates, cups, or cutlery.

plastic-bag-film.quote: NO plastic bags or stretchy plastic of any type: pallet wrap, bubble wrap, stretch wrap.

pill-bottle.quote: NO prescription medicine bottles or other plastic containers smaller than 2" by 2".

textiles-clothing.quote: Plastic bags, stretchy plastics, ropes, cords, wires, and clothing jam sorting machines.

aluminum-foil.quote: Aluminum foil and aluminum trays if clean, dry, and balled up to at least the size of a baseball.

aerosol-can.note: Cans that still contain liquid go to hazardous waste.

paint-can.quote: Empty and dry metal paint cans.

scrap-metal.quote: Scrap metal (smaller than 18 inches and less than 10 pounds).

metal-lids-caps.quote: To recycle small metal pieces (under 2 inches), like metal lids, screws and nails, collect inside a soup can, crimp tightly closed, then put into mixed recycling.

battery-alkaline.quote: Any battery that can fit into a 1-quart, zip-sealed plastic bag
battery-alkaline.note: Houses bag batteries and set them on top of glass in the glass bin.

battery-lithium.note: Items with embedded batteries are not accepted.

electronics.quote: NO items with embedded batteries (Cell phones, laptops, wireless headphones, bluetooth speakers, fitness watches/bands, electric toothbrushes, reading lights, etc.)
electronics.note: Electronics go to a Metro drop-off.

glass-bottle-jar.note: Goes in the separate glass-only bin, not the blue cart.

diapers-hygiene.quote: Diapers, sharps, and other medical waste create health hazards for workers.

sharps-medical.quote: Diapers, sharps, and other medical waste create health hazards for workers.
